giri 🍙 (@OnigiriEn_)

It is finally time to announce our super cool project!

GiriEats is an interactive food map where you can find all your favourite creator's eats!

Originally we planned on creating a food recommendation map that only included my fwends in Japan, but it ended up becoming an interactive globe with recommendations from a TON of creators worldwide XD.

We really wanted to do something that would include as many people as possible. Something that both creators and viewers could use together and have a little bit of fun with!

It is completely free to use, use it to save your favourite restaurants, share it with your friends, family, and most importantly your community!

We hope that you guys enjoy this as much as we have enjoyed making it! Huge shoutout to all the early creators that contributed to the foodge map because without them, this wouldnt nearly be as cool as it is now!! and will become!!!
